content.title: The Gamma-ray Luminosity Function of Fermi BL Lacertae Objects
content.abstract: We have used the largest sample of gamma-ray-selected Fermi BL Lacertae objects (1035 BL Lacs) ever used to determine the luminosity function and its evolution through cosmic time. This sample has its survey biases and selection effects well studied and a robust calculation of its detection efficiency. It spans a large range in luminosity ($L_{γ,min}$ = $5.71\times10^{40}$ erg s$^{-1}$ and $L_{γ,max}$ = $1.76\times10^{48}$ erg s$^{-1}$) and redshift ($ 0 < z \lesssim 4 $).
